_comment: Trees per proficiency. layer = proficiency level that unlocks the node. effects = value gained PER POINT; after 'diminishingAfter' points the gain is halved. base = fixed value the node has once learned, not multiplied by points (Wide Slash arc, Shield Bash stun, Bulwark 3 s + 0.2 s per point). synergies: bonus THIS node gets per point invested in 'from'. cooldown = cooldown in seconds (actives). description = tooltip text; {stat} is replaced by the value at the shown level (labels and formats in stats.json). barSlots = slots on the action bar (GDD 6.1); the keys for each slot are in ui/keys.json.

nodes.name: Precise Strike
nodes.description: A focused strike against one enemy that deals {damagePct} more damage and gains {accuracyPct} accuracy.

nodes.name: Sharp Blade
nodes.description: Your sword cuts deeper: {swordDamagePct} more damage with swords. Also boosts Shield Bash.

nodes.name: Wide Slash
nodes.description: Sweeps every enemy in a {arcDegrees} arc in front of you, aimed at the mouse, dealing {damagePct} more damage.

nodes.name: Bleed
nodes.description: Hits have a {bleedChance} chance to make the enemy bleed, taking {bleedDamagePct} of your weapon damage each second.

nodes.name: Charge
nodes.description: Rush up to {rangeTiles} toward the target and strike it, dealing {damagePct} more damage.

nodes.name: Combat Rhythm
nodes.description: Each hit in a row grants {attackSpeedPerStackPct} attack speed, stacking up to {maxStacks} times.

nodes.name: Whirlwind
nodes.description: Spin while you hold the key, hitting every enemy around you with {damagePct} more damage. Drains Energy every second.

nodes.name: Killing Blow
nodes.description: {critChanceLowLife} more critical chance against enemies below {lowLifeThreshold} life.

nodes.name: Defensive Stance
nodes.description: Your guard holds better: each block stops {blockReduction} more of the hit, costs less Energy ({guardEfficiency} guard efficiency) and you recover from it {fasterBlockRecovery} faster. Some damage always gets through a block.

nodes.name: Shield Bash
nodes.description: Slam one enemy with your shield for {damagePct} more damage, knocking it back {knockbackTiles} and stunning it for {stunSeconds}. Unique monsters and bosses are pushed and stunned for half as long.

nodes.name: Parry
nodes.description: Widens the perfect window at the start of the guard by {perfectWindowSeconds}. A perfect block counterattacks for {counterDamagePct} more damage.

nodes.name: Heavy Shield
nodes.description: {shieldArmorPct} more shield armor and a guard arc {guardArcDegrees} wider.

nodes.name: Bulwark
nodes.description: For {durationSeconds} your raised guard covers all around you (360°) and blocks without spending Energy. Hold the guard key to make use of it.

nodes.name: Riposte
nodes.description: After a block, your next attack deals {damageAfterBlockPct} more damage.

nodes.name: Shield Throw
nodes.description: Throw your shield in a straight line toward the mouse, up to {rangeTiles}. On a hit it flies on to the nearest enemy within {bounceRangeTiles}, bouncing {bounces} times; each hit deals {damagePct} more damage. Needs a shield.

nodes.name: Bastion
nodes.description: {allResistWithShield} to all resistances while a shield is equipped.

nodes.name: Iron Skin
nodes.description: {armorPct} more total armor.

nodes.name: Recovery
nodes.description: Regenerates {lifeRegenPerSecond} life per second, even in combat.

nodes.name: Steadfast
nodes.description: Stuns and knockbacks on you are {ccReduction} shorter, and you recover from heavy hits {fasterHitRecovery} faster.

nodes.name: Second Wind
nodes.description: When your life drops below {threshold}, you instantly heal {healPctOfMax} of your max life. Works once every {cooldownSeconds}.

nodes.name: War Cry
nodes.description: Enemies within {radiusTiles} deal {enemyDamageReduction} less damage for {durationSeconds}.

nodes.name: Elemental Resistance
nodes.description: Adds {elementalResist} to fire, cold and lightning resistance.

nodes.name: Unshakable
nodes.description: {deferredDamagePct} of the damage you take is delayed and spread over {deferSeconds}.

nodes.name: Colossus
nodes.description: {maxLifePct} more max life and {damagePerMissingLife10Pct} more damage for every 10% of life you are missing.
